name: APP SYSTEMS SERVICES PTE LTD
india_angle: APP Systems Services has sales offices and service centers in India, indicating a strategic presence in the region.
summary: APP Systems Services Pte Ltd is a distributor and service provider specializing in high technology products for critical processes in the semiconductor industry, including vacuum and plasma technologies. They represent leading global brands and offer comprehensive solutions to meet the demands of semiconductor and adjacent industries in Southeast Asia and India.
